title: The Staff role dropdown groups roles into System Roles and Custom Roles
preconds:
1. At least one custom role exists.
  2. You are logged in as an admin on the Staff page.
steps:
1. Go to Settings > Staff.
  2. Find a user row and open their role selector.
  3. Look at the dropdown.
expected: The dropdown has two groups: System Roles (the 11 built-in roles) and Custom Roles (the admin-created roles).
